title: SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additi

translated_title: SERAG：面向知识图谱异常检测的语义与关系方法
translated_abstract: 从文本构建的知识图谱中可能包含那些单独看来合理、但与其关系上下文不一致的事实。我们提出了SERAG，一种有监督异常检测器，它结合了两种互补的合理性估计：一种是由分别编码的主语、关系和宾语标签计算得到的语义分数，另一种是通过关系图卷积网络获得的关系分数。两种分数经过标准化、校准后进行融合。我们在ICEWS18数据集的一个子集上评估该方法，使用由大语言模型生成的受词表约束的合成异常，并采用混合划分和按时间顺序划分两种实验设置。在10%的异常比例下，SERAG分别取得了0.321和0.258的测试AUPRC，而最强适应基线仅分别为0.159和0.146。融合策略相比任一单独分支均提升了平均测试AUPRC，其中在混合划分协议中提升更大，在按时间顺序划分协议中经验证集选择的提升较小。
tldr: SERAG通过融合基于标签编码的语义分数和关系图卷积网络的关系分数，实现对知识图谱中异常事实的有监督检测，在ICEWS18上显著超越最强基线。
en_tdlr: SERAG is a supervised anomaly detector for knowledge graphs that fuses semantic scores from separately encoded subject-relation-object labels with relational scores from a relational graph convolutional network, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline on ICEWS18.
